verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents an On-premise, self-hosted edition for organizations that want to manage their own data, including inside existing PCI or HIPAA compliant environments. That gives customers control over where their data lives, but only by running the product themselves. Missing for 10: any documented choice of region for the hosted SaaS (e.g. EU vs US data centers), residency guarantees or commitments, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the on-premise option.
